summary: Mike Conroy, 49, of Joplin, MO, overdue hiker separated from church group at Weminuche Pass (Weminuche Trail/Divide Trail junction); spent the night on the mountain after misjudging cross-country route to Squaw Creek Trail; walked into 30-Mile Campground unharmed the next morning.
responding_agency: Hinsdale County SAR, Hinsdale County Sheriff's Office (Flight for Life A-Star staged for air search)
notes: Reported overdue late June 23 by church group; SAR response mobilized that evening, air search planned for June 24 morning; Conroy walked in unharmed shortly before helicopter launch; evaluated on scene, no treatment needed.
